19491-the-way-of-ambition.title: Way Of Ambition
19491-the-way-of-ambition.creator: Unknown
19491-the-way-of-ambition.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "An absolutely new note," interrupted Max Elliot with enthusiastic emphasis, turning to the man with the sarcastic mouth who had just spoken. "Your French blood makes you so inclined to incredulity, Paul, that you are incapable of believing anything but that I am carried away."

arxiv-2008-03250.title: Hyper Resolute Ultra thin Low Cost All-Dielectric Broadband Achromatic Metalenses
arxiv-2008-03250.creator: Giuseppe Emanuele Lio, Antonio Ferraro, Tiziana Ritacco, Dante Maria Aceti, Antonio De Luca, Roberto Caputo, Michele Giocondo
arxiv-2008-03250.description: Abstract Metalenses offer the ground-breaking opportunity to realize highly performing low-weight, flat and ultrathin, optical elements which substantially reduce size and complexity of imaging systems. Today, a major challenge in metalenses design is still the realization of achromatic optical elements ideally focussing a broad wavelength spectrum at a single focal length.

arxiv-2012-15429.title: On the Cauchy problem for the Hunter-Saxton equation on the line
arxiv-2012-15429.creator: Weikui Ye and, Zhaoyang Yin
arxiv-2012-15429.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the Cauchy problem for the Hunter-Saxton (HS) equation on the line. Firstly, we establish the local well-posedness for the integral form of the (HS) equation by constructing some special spaces E p , r s E^{s}_{p,r} , which mix Lebesgue spaces and homogeneous Besov spaces.

arxiv-2103-16184.title: Chromospheric and coronal heating and jet acceleration due to reconnection driven by flux cancellation
arxiv-2103-16184.creator: P. Syntelis, E. R. Priest
arxiv-2103-16184.description: Abstract Context. Recent observations have shown that magnetic flux cancellation occurs at the photosphere more frequently than previously thought. Aims. In order to understand the energy release by reconnection driven by flux cancellation, we previously studied a simple model of two cancelling polarities of equal flux.

arxiv-2103-17132.title: Empirically explaining SGD from a line search perspective
arxiv-2103-17132.creator: Maximus Mutschler, Andreas Zell
arxiv-2103-17132.description: Abstract Optimization in Deep Learning is mainly guided by vague intuitions and strong assumptions, with a limited understanding of how and why these work in practice. To shed more light on this, our work provides a deeper understanding of how SGD behaves by empirically analyzing the trajectory taken by SGD from a line search perspective.

arxiv-2111-12044.title: Quantum process tomography of adiabatic and superadiabatic stimulated Raman passage
arxiv-2111-12044.creator: Shruti Dogra, Gheorghe Sorin Paraoanu
arxiv-2111-12044.description: Abstract Quantum control methods for three-level systems have become recently an important direction of research in quantum information science and technology. Here we present numerical simulations using realistic experimental parameters for quantum process tomography in STIRAP (stimulated Raman adiabatic passage) and saSTIRAP (superadiabatic STIRAP).

arxiv-2312-11105.title: Weak Poissonian box correlations of higher order
arxiv-2312-11105.creator: Jasmin Fiedler and Christian Weiß
arxiv-2312-11105.description: Abstract . Poissonian pair correlations have sparked interest within the mathematical community, because of their number theoretic properties, and their connections to quantum physics and probability theory, in particular uniformly distributed random numbers. Rather recently, several generalizations of the concept have been introduced, including weak Poissonian pair correlations and k k -th order Poissonian correlations.

arxiv-2401-15050.title: LongFin: A Multimodal Document Understanding Model for Long Financial Domain Documents
arxiv-2401-15050.creator: Ahmed Masry, Amir Hajian
arxiv-2401-15050.description: Abstract Document AI is a growing research field that focuses on the comprehension and extraction of information from scanned and digital documents to make everyday business operations more efficient. Numerous downstream tasks and datasets have been introduced to facilitate the training of AI models capable of parsing and extracting information from various document types such as receipts and scanned forms.

arxiv-2410-07451.title: Collective variables of neural networks: empirical time evolution and scaling laws
arxiv-2410-07451.creator: Samuel Tovey, Sven Krippendorf, Michael Spannowsky, Konstantin Nikolaou, Christian Holm
arxiv-2410-07451.description: Abstract This work presents a novel means for understanding learning dynamics and scaling relations in neural networks. We show that certain measures on the spectrum of the empirical neural tangent kernel, specifically entropy and trace, yield insight into the representations learned by a neural network and how these can be improved through architecture scaling.

arxiv-2510-09485.title: Locally Optimal Private Sampling: Beyond the Global Minimax
arxiv-2510-09485.creator: Hrad Ghoukasian, Bonwoo Lee, Shahab Asoodeh
arxiv-2510-09485.description: Abstract We study the problem of sampling from a distribution under local differential privacy (LDP). Given a private distribution P ∈ 𝒫 P\in\mathcal{P} , the goal is to generate a single sample from a distribution that remains close to P P in f f -divergence while satisfying the constraints of LDP.

arxiv-2512-11572.description: Abstract We present James Webb Space Telescope ( JWST ) and Hubble Space Telescope ( HST ) observations of the counterpart of EP 240801a, at z = 1.67 z=1.67 , the first fast X-ray transient (FXT) identified as an X-ray flash (XRF) by the Einstein Probe (EP) and Fermi -GBM.

pmc-10843382.title: ﻿A survey of pholcid spiders (Araneae, Pholcidae) from Guiyang, Guizhou Province, China
pmc-10843382.creator: Lan Yang, Fangyu Zhao, Qiaoqiao He, Zhiyuan Yao
pmc-10843382.description: ﻿AbstractThe family Pholcidae C.L. Koch, 1850 is highly diverse in Guizhou Province, southwestern China, and currently contains four genera and 22 species. Nevertheless, the distribution of pholcid spiders is conspicuously patchy in Guizhou. Species from Guiyang are poorly studied, and only Pholcusspilis Zhu & Gong, 1991 has been recorded.

pmc-11688357.title: Transcriptome-based WGCNA reveals the molecular regulation of xylem plasticity in acclimation to drought and rewatering in mulberry
pmc-11688357.creator: Yue Tian, Zeyang Zhai, Yujie Yang, Kaixin Zhang, Sang Ma, Jialing Cheng, Li Liu, Xu Cao
pmc-11688357.description: Xylem plasticity is important for trees to coordinate hydraulic efficiency and safety under changing soil water availability. However, the physiological and transcriptional regulations of cambium on xylem plasticity are not well understood. In this study, mulberry saplings of drought-resistant Wubu and drought-susceptible Zhongshen1 were subjected to moderate or severe drought stresses for 21 days and subsequently rewatered for 12 days.

pmc-11715385.title: Metabolomics approaches for capturing the chemical exposome and its influences on cognitive function and brain health
pmc-11715385.creator: M Arthur Moseley, Oliver Fiehn, Pieter Dorrestein, Tuulia Hyotylainen, Matej Oresic, David Wishart, Nina Zhao, Rima F Kaddurah‐Daouk, Alzheimer's Gut Microbiome Project Consortium (AGMP)
pmc-11715385.description: BackgroundThere is growing interest in the role of environmental factors (i.e., exposome) in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer’s diseases. The exposome includes three categories: internal (e.g., metabolism, gut microbiome, inflammation), specific external (e.g., environmental pollutants, diet, drugs, occupational), and general external (e.g., socioeconomic status, education, climate).

pmc-12565691.title: Non-Invasive Wearable Technology to Predict Heart Failure Decompensation
pmc-12565691.creator: Jack Devin, Eden Powell, Dylan McGagh, Tyler Jones, Brian Wang, Pierre Le Page, Andrew J. M. Lewis, Oliver J. Rider, Andrew R. J. Mitchell, John A. Henry
pmc-12565691.description: Heart failure (HF) remains a leading cause of recurrent hospitalisations worldwide, largely driven by acute episodes of decompensation. Early identification of impending decompensation could enable timely intervention and potentially prevent costly admissions. Non-invasive wearable devices have emerged as promising tools for continuously monitoring physiological parameters and detecting early signs of deterioration.

pmc-12594215.title: Highly Sensitive Field Detection Technology for Anthrax Based on the CRISPR/Cas13a System
pmc-12594215.creator: Jiao Fan, Luyao Huang, Jiahui Chen, Yaxuan Jiang, Xinying Du, Ligui Wang, Kanghui Ding, Jun Huang, Shaofu Qiu, Hongbo Liu, Hongbin Song
pmc-12594215.description: In this study, we established a highly sensitive on‐site detection technology for Bacillus anthracis . Firstly, we integrated Multiple Enzyme Isothermal Rapid Amplification (MIRA) with the clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR) /associated protein 13a (CRISPR/Cas13a) detection system to develop a highly sensitive CRISPR/Cas13a assay.

pmc-12606095.title: Evaluation of antimicrobial efficacy of Psidium guajava L. leaf extract in ketoconazole shampoo
pmc-12606095.creator: Fuad Al-Rimawi, Hamada Imtara, Jehad Abbadi, Saleh Sawalha, Mohammad Atiya, Samer Mudalal, Gianluigi Mauriello
pmc-12606095.description: Despite their effectiveness, synthetic preservatives are often associated with adverse health effects, which has led to growing interest in natural alternatives. This study evaluated the antimicrobial activity of an ethanolic extract of Psidium guajava L. leaves incorporated into a shampoo formulation. The ethanolic extract of Psidium guajava L. leaves was tested at concentrations of 0.5%, 2.5%, 5%, 7.

pmc-12711575.title: Laser spectroscopy and CP-violation sensitivity of actinium monofluoride
pmc-12711575.creator: M. Athanasakis-Kaklamanakis, M. Au, A. Kyuberis, C. Zülch, K. Gaul, H. Wibowo, L. Skripnikov, L. Lalanne, J. R. Reilly, Á. Koszorús, S. Bara, J. Ballof, R. Berger, C. Bernerd, A. Borschevsky, A. A. Breier, K. Chrysalidis, T. E. Cocolios, R. P. de Groote, A. Dorne, J. Dobaczewski, C. M. Fajardo Zambr
pmc-12711575.description: The apparent invariance of the strong nuclear force under combined charge conjugation and parity (CP) remains an open question in modern physics1,2. Precision experiments with heavy atoms and molecules can provide stringent constraints on CP violation via searches for effects due to permanent electric dipole moments and other CP-odd properties in leptons, hadrons and nuclei3.

pmc-12719661.title: Rare but relevant: Genetic liver disease in the general medical setting
pmc-12719661.creator: Sammi Allouni, Aftab Ala
pmc-12719661.description: Highlights•Genetic liver diseases are often missed due to non-specific symptoms.•Wilson disease, hereditary hemochromatosis and A1AT deficiency can present to generalists.•Genomic testing enables earlier diagnosis and tailored treatment.•Earlier recognition improves outcomes and supports family cascade testing.•Generalists play a key role in integrating genomics into liver disease care.

pmc-12786218.title: The Effects of FKBP12 Single-Dose Plasmid Oral Preparation on the Alkaline Phosphatase Activity, Mortality Rate, and Cocoon Quality of Bivoltine Jinqiu × Churi Silkworms
pmc-12786218.creator: Jiaqi Chen, Ziyu Song, Wenbin Li, Haoyang Feng, Yani Wang, Dajin Wang, Si Li
pmc-12786218.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Although naturally colored silk is an excellent textile material and biomedical material, some silkworm varieties—such as the bivoltine strain Jinqiu × Churi—exhibit a relatively low cocoon shell ratio, which limits their economic value. This study, therefore, aimed to develop a novel approach to enhance larval survival and cocoon quality by orally administering a single dose of a recombinant pIEx-1-FKBP12B plasmid to silkworm larvae at different instars.

pmc-13185308.title: Deep-learning-based diagnostic models for transcutaneous oxygen pressure-defined peripheral arterial disease and lower extremity wound healing in patients with diabetic foot
pmc-13185308.creator: Ming-Feng Tsai, Chen-Shen Shih, Yu-Fan Chen, Yu-Chang Chu, Chieh-Ming Yu, Wen-Teng Yao, Ya-Shu Chan, Chia-Meng Yu, Shu-Tien Huang, Liong-Rung Liu, Lang-Hua Chiu, Yueh-Hung Lin, Chin-Yi Yang, Kung-Chen Ho, Wen-Chen Huang, Kwang-Yi Tung, Fei-Hung Hung, Hung-Wen Chiu
pmc-13185308.description: BackgroundFew studies have evaluated peripheral artery disease (PAD) and wound healing in patients with lower extremity wounds using a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based deep learning algorithm. We aimed to establish a CNN deep-learning model based on transcutaneous oxygen pressure (TcPO2)-annotated wound images for detecting PAD and wound healing in diabetic patients with lower extremity wounds.

pmc-13321898.title: IGFBP in tumor immunity: a novel target for cancer immunotherapy
pmc-13321898.creator: Qingqiang Lei, Liangbin Lin, Hui Yu
pmc-13321898.description: BackgroundThe insulin-like growth factor-binding protein (IGFBP) family consists of soluble bioactive molecules that, together with insulin-like growth factors (IGFs) and their receptors, are critical modulators of endocrine, metabolic, and immune functions. IGFBPs serve as signaling intermediaries in fundamental cellular processes such as migration, differentiation, proliferation, and apoptosis.

pmc-13359743.title: Morphostructural, Phaneroptic Characterization, and Zoometric Indices of Creole Cattle (Bos taurus) from the High Andean Region of Ayacucho, Peru
pmc-13359743.creator: Mijail Contreras Huamaní, César Jorge Mendoza Leiva, Jhoel Kevin Alvaro Peralta, Hamilton Guzman Santaria, Walter Palomino-Guerrera, Hurley Abel Quispe-Ccasa
pmc-13359743.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryHigh-Andean Creole cattle have become an endemic resource of great socioeconomic interest in remote regions due to their adaptability and phenotypic–genotypic diversity, which should be conserved and sustainably utilized. The objective of this study was to carry out a morphostructural characterization of Creole cows in the districts of Chuschi and Chipao, Ayacucho, Peru, at 3800 m above sea level, through the recording of body measurements and qualitative traits.

pmc-13499399.title: Homologous recombination deficiency testing implementation in the routine clinical setting: real-life experience and lessons learned
pmc-13499399.creator: P. Romero-Lozano, M. Gómez-Rey, M. Vila-Casadesús, A. Martin, G. Buono, V. Bach, A. Onieva, M. Ricart, N. Deltiempo, E. Castillo, L. Fariñas, S. Aguilar, E. Garralda, R. Dienstmann, P. Nuciforo, J. Tabernero, C. Garcia-Duran, A Vivancos
pmc-13499399.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHomologous recombination deficiency (HRD) is a critical biomarker for predicting response to poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors in high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC). Hence, genomic scar-based HRD testing must be implemented in routine clinical labs.

pmc-13520334.creator: Nikolina Peranić, Lucija Božičević, Nikolina Kalčec, Korinna Altmann, Jana Hildebrandt, Carlos Cuestas Ayllon, Raquel Portela, Jesús M. de la Fuente, Miguel A. Bañares, Ivana Vinković Vrček

pmc-13623529.title: Pharmacokinetics of Clofazimine Tablet Formulation in Children with Rifampicin-Resistant Tuberculosis in CATALYST, a Multi-Site International Trial
pmc-13623529.creator: Yuanxi Zou, Megan Palmer, Melchor V G Frias, Dessa J O Casalme, Aarti A Kinikar, Mandar Paradkar, Vandana Kulkarni, Pragathi Kamath, Ingrid Courtney, Heather Draper, Lubbe Wiesner, Mats O Karlsson, Paolo Denti, Louvina van der Laan, Anthony J Garcia-Prats, Anneke C Hesseling, Elin M Svensson
pmc-13623529.description: We evaluated the pharmacokinetics of a novel child-friendly 50 mg clofazimine tablet formulation that disperses quickly in water, compared to traditional gel capsules, in 36 children routinely treated for rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis. No substantial pharmacokinetic difference was observed between tablets and gel capsules, supporting the tablet formulation use for paediatric dosing.

pmc-13682137.title: Robot-assisted mechanically aligned total knee arthroplasty: comparing early outcomes between varus and non-varus knees, and between CPAK Type I and Type IV subtypes
pmc-13682137.creator: Pengpeng Li, Jihe Ban, Yunhai Liu, Juan Li, Jichao Hu
pmc-13682137.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to compare early pain relief and functional recovery between varus and non-varus phenotypes following robot-assisted mechanically aligned total knee arthroplasty (MA-TKA), with a specific focus on the two most common varus subtypes: Type I and Type IV.MethodsA retrospective analysis was performed on 124 patients who underwent primary unilateral robot-assisted MA-TKA.

uslaw-usc-t16-s410k.title: 16 U.S.C. § 410k — Limitation of Federal action during reservation period
uslaw-usc-t16-s410k.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s410k.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LIV (Everglades National Park). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Unless consented to by an owner retaining the reservation set forth in subsections (1) and (2) of section 410j of this title, no action shall be taken by the Federal Government during the period of such reservation.
